notes: CEO interventions. Every wrong decision is a strike. Strikes 1-2: Aditya walks into Alice's office with a warning (the 2nd uses final_headline/final_lines). Strike 3: summon + fired. {name} = candidate, {mistakes} = list.

reject_good.headline: ALICE! WAIT!
lines: Do you even understand who you just rejected?
{name} was one of the strongest applicants we received tonight.
This is your last chance, Alice. Reopen the file and do it neatly.
Or you will see what I do with you.
final_lines: That is the second time tonight you have thrown away someone this company needed.
{name}. Look at the file. Look at it properly.
One more mistake and you will be standing in my office, not yours.

accept_dangerous.headline: ALICE, WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?
lines: You approved {name} without checking the employment history?
Do you realise what one wrong person with a badge could cost this company?
This is your last chance, Alice. Do it neatly this time.
Or you will see what I do with you.
lines_if_warned: You SAW the warning signs on {name}. You logged them yourself.
And you approved the application anyway?
This is your last chance, Alice. Fix it. Neatly.
Or you will see what I do with you.
final_lines: You have now tried to put two wrong people inside this building.
{name} does not get a badge while I am alive.
One more mistake and you will be standing in my office, not yours.

after_keep.reject_good: ...Your name is on that file now. Remember that I warned you.
after_keep.accept_dangerous: Then whatever happens next is on you. And so am I.

after_review.reject_good: Good. Read it properly this time. I'll be watching the dashboard.
after_review.accept_dangerous: Faster, Alice. I won't come down here twice.

report_call.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
report_call.text: Six files. Six decisions. I've seen the dashboard.

report_call.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
report_call.text: Print your report, Alice. I want it on my desk before the rain stops.

fired.text: Floor 31. The executive office. The rain is louder up here.

fired.speaker: ADITYA
fired.text: Sit down. No — stand. This won't take long.

fired.speaker: ADITYA
fired.text: I gave you two chances. Most people in this building never get one.

fired.speaker: ALICE
fired.text: Sir, the evidence was— I can fix this. Give me the files back.

fired.speaker: ADITYA
fired.text: There is nothing left to fix. Leave your badge on my desk.

game_over.title: TERMINATED
game_over.text: Alice's access card stops working at 03:13. By morning her desk on Floor 13 has been cleared, and a new name is being printed for the door. The rain does not stop.
